The '''Fifteenth Pius Dea Crusade''' was a religious [[Pius Dea Crusades|crusade]] orchestrated by the [[Pius Dea]] cult and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Contispex XI]] against the [[Baragwin/Legends|Baragwins]]. In [[11,591 BBY]], the Pius Dea&ndash;controlled [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] launched an invasion of [[Old Barag/Legends|Old Barag]].<ref name="EGW" /> Nearby planets, such as [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]], were targeted during the crusade as well on the grounds of religious liberty. The [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] formed the [[Tayan League]] from military veterans of the [[Doellinism/Legends|Doellin religion]] to resist the proselytizing of Contispex.<ref name="SoR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Fifteenth Pius Dea Crusade first appeared in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''. While the Fifteenth Crusade is not mentioned explicitly in the text, the Crusade appears on a map of the Crusades and their movement across the galaxy.<ref name="EGW" />
